package.name: cell_backend_hw
package.description: Hardware implementation (scaffold) of the cell_platform_interfaces backends for the UR cell on the UR AI Accelerator: motion through the UR ROS 2 driver's trajectory controller, gripper through the OnRobot RG6 URCap over URScript (no readings over ROS 2 yet), poses from /camera1/poses and /camera2/poses, scene reset by operator confirmation. Every unknown is a TODO(mohammad) in config/platforms/hardware.yaml. Python 3.10 / ROS 2 Humble.
